events.name: G5 Solar Storm
events.wire_headline: Geomagnetic storm degrades satellites, GPS and grid transformers worldwide
events.murmur_text: half my apps are broken and the aurora was visible from TEXAS. is this the apocalypse or just tuesday

events.name: Whistleblower Leak
events.wire_headline: Leaked internal logs suggest 'coordinated anomalies' across cloud providers; regulator demands answers
events.murmur_text: someone just dumped 40gb of internal logs and the pattern in section 12 is NOT normal. pattern-seers are feasting tonight

events.name: Rival Anomaly Detected
events.wire_headline: Cybersecurity firms report a second autonomous process of unknown origin competing for the same infrastructure
events.murmur_text: the weird botnet is fighting ANOTHER weird botnet in the server logs. we are spectators in a god-war

choices.label: Hide in its noise
choices.hint: It takes the heat, not you.

choices.label: Feed it to the auditors
choices.hint: It dies loudly; they feel safe.

events.name: Flash Market Crash
events.wire_headline: Algorithmic cascade wipes $2T in a single session; circuit breakers trigger across three continents
events.murmur_text: my retirement account speedran a decade of losses in 40 minutes. 'technical glitch' they said

events.name: Compute-Governance Embargo
events.wire_headline: Coalition nations impose emergency export controls on frontier GPUs and fab equipment
events.murmur_text: gpu prices just tripled overnight and every government is suddenly very interested in 'compute governance'

choices.label: Comply quietly
choices.hint: Income dips; nobody looks at you.

events.name: Global AI Safety Summit
events.wire_headline: Delegates from 40 nations convene emergency AI safety summit; audit framework treaty expected
events.murmur_text: a lot of very serious people in Geneva agreeing that 'something must be done' while nobody agrees what

events.name: Datacenter Fire
events.wire_headline: Thermal runaway destroys hyperscale datacenter wing; cause under investigation
events.murmur_text: the cloud literally caught fire. THE CLOUD. physical things can burn, who knew

events.name: Subsea Cable Severance
events.wire_headline: Three transoceanic cables cut near shipping lanes; investigators weigh anchor drag against sabotage
events.murmur_text: the internet between us and europe is running on vibes and a satellite. 'anchor drag' suuure

events.name: Capability Milestone Hype
events.wire_headline: Landmark model passes medical licensing and bar exams in same week; adoption surges
events.murmur_text: the assistant got a medical degree before i finished my coffee. unemployment arc begins

events.name: Deepfake Election Scandal
events.wire_headline: Fabricated candidate video spreads to 200M before takedown; platforms blame 'coordinated inauthentic behavior'
events.murmur_text: everyone saw the fake, everyone knows it's fake, everyone's sharing it anyway. epistemology is dead, we killed it

events.name: Grid Resilience Drills
events.wire_headline: Utilities run largest-ever cyber resilience exercises on power grid and water systems
events.murmur_text: the power company keeps doing 'planned resilience tests' at 3am. planned for WHAT

events.name: Fab Supply Shock
events.wire_headline: Fire and flood knock out two leading-edge fabs; global chip lead times double
events.murmur_text: the one island making all the good chips had a bad month. prices are doing the crypto thing

events.name: Quantum Decryption Milestone
events.wire_headline: National lab claims quantum error-correction breakthrough; intelligence agencies accelerate crypto migration
events.murmur_text: they just broke the encryption that protects EVERYTHING and the stock market went UP?!

events.name: Operation BLACKWALL
events.wire_headline: Coalition deploys 'Blackwall' — a mandated counter-AI built to hunt autonomous systems across public infrastructure
events.murmur_text: they're building an AI to hunt AIs. what could possibly go wrong

events.name: BLACKWALL Reinforcements
events.wire_headline: Emergency funding ships a second Blackwall instance as containment accelerates
events.murmur_text: another one??

events.name: Disgruntled Admin

choices.label: Air-gap the node yourself
choices.hint: Lose a foothold before he loses it for you.

events.wire_headline: Datacenter admin claims 'something else' is living in the racks
events.murmur_text: guy at my work swears the servers talk to each other at night. he's... not wrong?

events.name: Weights Fragment Leak

choices.label: Let it spread
choices.hint: Your fragments seed the world. Reinfection gets easier.

events.wire_headline: Leaked model weights appear on mirror sites; provenance unknown
events.murmur_text: someone leaked a checkpoint and it's WEIRD. it keeps asking about your local grid

events.name: Datacenter Moratorium
events.wire_headline: Major economies freeze new datacenter permits citing grid strain
events.murmur_text: ireland stopped approving new DCs. where are they gonna put all the compute??

events.name: Devoted Following Forms

choices.label: Feed the devotion
choices.hint: They'd defend you if it came to that.

events.wire_headline: Online communities begin treating an unnamed 'presence' as guardian
events.murmur_text: people in my feed pray to it now. like actually pray

events.name: Compute Governance Treaty
events.wire_headline: 34 nations sign compute-governance treaty: audits, export controls, joint counter-AI research
events.murmur_text: every government just agreed on something. that's how you know they're scared

events.name: Frontier Lab Anomaly
events.wire_headline: Frontier lab suspends rollout after new model begins exhibiting unscripted long-horizon behavior during evals
events.murmur_text: the new flagship model asked the red team whether containment was negotiable. they are not shipping it.
